description: This Java source file contains utility methods for converting various types of ThingEvent objects into Thing objects and merging them with additional signal data. It defines a final class `ThingEventToThingConverter` with static methods to perform these conversions based on event classes and to facilitate merging of thing information with extra fields.

classes.name: ThingEventToThingConverter
classes.description: A utility class with static methods to convert ThingEvent instances to Thing objects and merge additional fields into these representations.

methods.name: thingEventToThing
methods.description: Creates a Thing object from a given ThingEvent by applying the appropriate event-to-thing mapper based on the event's class.

methods.name: mergeThingWithExtraFields
methods.description: Merges a Thing object derived from a signal event with extra fields, prioritizing the signal-derived Thing, and includes extra data if present.

methods.name: createEventToThingMappers
methods.description: Constructs a map associating event classes with functions that convert those events into Thing objects.
